desc: Parse the parenthesis sequence into a rooted ordered forest and formalize that reversing a valid substring reverses a contiguous run of siblings while applying reverse-complement to each child subtree.
Derive invariant: reachable strings are exactly the ordered forests isomorphic to the given unordered forest; count = product over nodes of multinomial coefficients by child shape.
Implement the tree canonicalization + multinomial-product solution in Python (iterative parsing, exact tuple-based shape IDs, modular factorials), reading stdin and writing stdout.
Verify against samples (Sample 1 -> 2, Sample 2 -> 1); passed both public samples.
